title: Driver State Detection
tagline: Real-time, webcam-based driver attention monitoring in Python using OpenCV and a custom ResNet50 facial keypoint model.
highlights: Eye aspect ratio, gaze and head-pose scoring
Warnings for asleep, looking away and distracted states
description: Forked from [e-candeloro/Driver-State-Detection](https://github.com/e-candeloro/Driver-State-Detection) and heavily modified to run a custom ResNet50 facial keypoint model, trained following a [debuggercafe.com tutorial](https://debuggercafe.com/robust-facial-keypoint-detection-model/). The cover shows that model's own training metrics.
